newsitem.title: USA: Mediator says AMR, pilot talks still difficult.
newsitem.headline: Mediator says AMR, pilot talks still difficult.

text.p: Federal Mediator Kenneth Hipp said on Thursday the labor talks between American Airlines, a unit of AMR Corp and its pilots continued to be slow and difficult.

He made the comment following four days of around-the- clock negotiations between the two sides in their effort to avert a union strike set for midnight Friday against American, the nation's number two airline.
He charaterized the pace of the talks for reporters as "still very slowly and with great difficulty."
He used the same phrase to characterize the pace earlier in the week.
Asked if the two sides have become entrenched in their positions, he said negotiators were cordial, although there was some tension between them.
